metadata.remarks:
Network Monitoring and Response defines the capability to provide continuous visibility into network activity, detect anomalous or malicious behavior, and initiate containment or response actions. Monitoring completes the network trust chain by ensuring that allowed connectivity remains observable, attributable, and enforceable over time.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for SSPPs, standards, procedures, guidelines, and assurance related to network visibility, detection, and response. Controls are scoped to monitoring and response sub‑capabilities to enable precise assessment of detection and containment effectiveness.

components.title: Flow Visibility
components.description: Collection and analysis of network traffic metadata to establish visibility into communications.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Monitor network traffic to detect unauthorized connections and activity.
Provide centralized generation and management of network audit records.

components.title: Anomaly Detection
components.description: Identification of abnormal or suspicious patterns in network behavior.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Analyze network activity to identify anomalous or potentially malicious behavior.

components.title: Containment Actions
components.description: Execution of network-level actions to contain or limit detected threats.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Implement coordinated containment actions in response to detected network incidents.
Restrict or block network communications to contain threats.

components.title: Response Coordination
components.description: Coordination of network response activities with security operations and incident response processes.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Coordinate network response actions with broader incident response procedures.
Support review and analysis of network security events.
